items.title: iv. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with Aqueous Silver Nitrate (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: iv. Reactions of Halogenoalkanes with Aqueous Silver Nitrate: a main subheading of 21.4 Examples of Reactions of Halogenoalkanes, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 82-84.

blocks.text: Yeh reaction paani aur ethanol ke mixture mein kiya jata hai; ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghulne (dissolve hone) mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ka kaam kar ke halogenoalkane se react karta hai aur halide ion ki jagah le leta hai.

Nikalne wala halide ion phir silver nitrate se react kar ke precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) deta hai, jis ka colour (rang) batata hai ke kaun sa halide ion maujood tha. Is tarah yeh reaction halogenoalkane mein halide ion ki pehchan mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Pani aur ethanol wale silver nitrate ki teen test tubes: chloroalkane se AgCl ka safaid (white) precipitate bohat dheere, bromoalkane se AgBr ka cream yellow precipitate tez, aur iodoalkane se AgI ka bright yellow precipitate sab se tez. Har tube ke neeche Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl, Ag+ + Br- -> AgBr, Ag+ + I- -> AgI.
blocks.caption: Silver nitrate se halogen ki pehchan (is reaction ko samjhane ke liye hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Precipitate ka rang halogen batata hai, aur jis speed (tezi) se woh nazar aata hai woh halogenoalkane ki reactivity dikhati hai: iodoalkane sab se jaldi, bromoalkane us ke baad, aur chloroalkane bohat dheere.

blocks.text: Is reaction mein silver halides kitni jaldi bante hain, yeh dekh kar halides ki reactivity ka idea (andaza) hota hai. Precipitate jitni jaldi aaye, halogenoalkane utna zyada reactive hai. Iodoalkane bromoalkane se bohat jaldi precipitate deta hai, jab ke chloroalkane bohat dheere react karta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Halogenoalkanes ko organic compounds ki bohat reactive class (qisam) kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: C – X bond polar hai, is liye carbon electrophilic (δ+) hai aur nucleophiles ka target (nishana) banta hai; halide ion achha leaving group hai; aur C – Cl, C – Br, C – I bonds relatively (doosron ke muqable mein) weak hain. Bases HX hata kar alkenes bhi bana sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Equation complete karein: C₂H₅Br + CH₃COONa →
blocks.explanation: C₂H₅Br + CH₃COONa → CH₃COOC₂H₅ (ethyl ethanoate) + NaBr. Ethanoate ion (CH₃COO⁻) nucleophile ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Ethane ko ethanol aur ethene mein kaise badlenge?
blocks.explanation: Pehle roshni mein ethane + Cl₂ → chloroethane + HCl. Phir chloroethane ko aqueous NaOH ke saath garam karein to ethanol; ethanol (alcohol) mein NaOH ke saath garam karein to ethene.

blocks.prompt: d) Bromopropane ka KCN se reaction likhein. Yeh substitution hai ya elimination? Main product ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂CH₂Br + KCN → CH₃CH₂CH₂CN + KBr (ethanol mein, reflux). Yeh nucleophilic substitution hai; main product butanenitrile hai.

items: Aqueous NaOH: alcohol (substitution); alcohol mein NaOH: alkene (elimination).
Ethanol mein KCN: nitrile (ek carbon zyada). NH₃: amines, aakhir mein quaternary ammonium salt.
AgNO₃ (paani + ethanol): AgCl white (safaid), AgBr cream yellow, AgI bright yellow (chamakdar peela); iodoalkane sab se tez, chloroalkane sab se dheere.
